_comment: Real sources for the Food Waste Reducer. No secrets. class_map keys = SOURCE labels; value = canonical taxonomy name, 'name:spoiled'/'name:fresh' to force freshness, or null to drop. Sources with "pending": true (or a missing root) are skipped by prepare_dataset.py. Roots are outside the repo under mldata/. 'drop_image_if_label' drops an entire image if it contains any listed unmodelled object (so it is not left unlabeled).

sources.name: vegqual
sources._note: Gourds are not taxonomy classes. 1615 of 4831 images are gourd-only (dropped automatically: no mapped boxes). 6 images mix gourds with other vegs; drop_image_if_label removes those so no gourd is left unlabeled.
